metadata.notes: Measured against SKILL.md and run-trials.sh as of this commit, after the four skill fixes, the priority-rule reorder, the SKILL.md split into references/, and the harness allowlist widening described in benchmark-baseline.md. Graded from per-service MCP call logs and a field-by-field diff of final stub state against the seed fixture.
